newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian silos firm says H1 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian silos firm says H1 profit up.

text.p: General Silos and Storage said on Monday it made pre-tax profits of 38 million pounds ($11.2 million) in the first half of the 1996/7 financial year, against 26 million in the same period of the previous year.

A company official said after-tax profits for the same period were 29 million. He did not have a comparative figure but the company made net after-tax profits of 47.856 million pounds in the whole of 1995/6. The years begin July 1.
The company said it expected even more profits in the second half of this year because handling capacity at its silos at Damietta port would increase.
The company was partially privatised in November at 39.00 pounds a share. The shares closed at 73.50 on Sunday.
